name: I Think My Wife Wants To Kill Me S2
original_name: I Think My Wife Wants To Kill Me S2
overview: After being falsely accused of her employer’s murder, Emily is cleared when detectives uncover the truth behind Madame Delacroix’s natural death and expose the conspiracy against her. Unexpectedly inheriting the late matriarch’s vast fortune, Emily sets out to fulfill one final promise by searching for her estranged son, Jamal. Though reluctant to accept her help, Jamal’s arrival at the manor marks the beginning of a journey filled with family secrets, redemption, and the chance to rebuild the life they both lost.
